findings.location: row gso::opt1-102, field version_status (and associated version)
findings.evidence: Primary sources (gso-bench.github.io page and leaderboard.json) publish no release/version identifier for the board: leaderboard.json metadata has only last_updated and total_tasks, model rows carry setting Opt@1, and the string "opt1-102" appears nowhere in the captured source. Criterion c2 requires version_status "published" to mean the maintainer publishes a release identifier that the row's version copies; without one, "snapshot" is the supported status.
findings.repair: Set version_status to "snapshot" and make version a dated snapshot identity (e.g., based on captured metadata.last_updated or retrieval date), or add primary evidence of a maintainer-published release identifier that opt1-102 copies; then re-review.

uncertainties: I could not execute SHA-256, transport, or qualification checks; owner-computed hashes and captured payloads were taken as given.

Version_status judgement depends on treating absence of an explicit maintainer release/version string as no release identifier; if Opt@1 plus metadata.total_tasks 102 is considered a published release identifier, the finding would not apply.
